description: Na₄Al₃Ge₃O₁₂I crystallizes in the cubic P̅43n space group. Na is bonded to three equivalent O and one I atom to form distorted NaIO₃ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaIO₃ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.31 Å. The Na-I bond length is 3.07 Å. Al is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form AlO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaIO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent GeO₄ tetrahedra. All Al-O bond lengths are 1.75 Å. Ge is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form GeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaIO₃ tetrahedra and corners with four equivalent AlO₄ tetrahedra. All Ge-O bond lengths are 1.75 Å. O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Al, and one Ge atom. I is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent Na atoms.
